t_agc.why: `Agc<float>` is an out-of-line template instantiation inside V90Demodulator.cpp. GCC 3.4.2 does not inline every call and emits the weak instantiation, which the period object carries; GCC 13+ inlines them all and emits nothing. Measured: of `-fno-partial-inlining -fno-ipa-cp`, `-fkeep-inline-functions`, `-fno-toplevel-reorder` and `-fno-inline`, only `-fno-inline` keeps the symbols -- and that changes code generation in every translation unit, which is not a declaration the modern tier may make. Issue #77; `make period` passes this binary with the object's own compiler.

t_diffcoder.why: Header-only `DifferentialEncoder`/`DifferentialDecoder` template instantiations. The period object emits the out-of-line weak copies because GCC 3.4.2 does not inline every call; GCC 13+ inlines them all away. Same class as t_agc, and the same measurement bounds it: no apparatus flag keeps them short of `-fno-inline`. Issue #77.
